# Reading Fluency Conference Notes

Subject: Intervention
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Conference Notes
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A conference template for tracking accuracy, phrasing, expression, and comprehension next steps.

## Alignment Note
Supports fluency, comprehension monitoring, and responsive reading instruction.

## Classroom Use Case
Use during one-on-one reading conferences or intervention block rotations.

## Preview Content
- Strength noticed
- Fluency focus
- One text-based question answered

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
